description: Build a PWM over an arbitrary alphabet (protein, RNA, …) from aligned instances (as create_alphabet_pwm; positive pseudocount so every cell is finite) and return the exact p-value of a score, P(S >= score) for a random i.i.d. background word (S = the window score of scan_with_alphabet_pwm), or the exact score threshold of a p-value (smallest word score t with P(S >= t) <= pValue) — the Touzet & Varré 2007 TFM-Pvalue engine of pwm_score_pvalue with K rows. Give exactly one of score / pValue.

score.description: Score threshold: returns P(S >= score). Omit when pValue is given.

pValue.description: Target p-value in [0,1]: returns the exact score threshold. Omit when score is given.

pseudocount.description: Pseudocount per cell (default 0.5; every cell must be finite)

background.description: Background in alphabet order (uniform when omitted)

ignoreUnknownSymbols.description: Skip symbols outside the alphabet when counting the instances

initialGranularity.description: TFM-Pvalue initial granularity (rounding step of the first integer matrix)

maxGranularity.description: TFM-Pvalue maximal (finest) granularity; omitted = limited only by g·Σmax|W| <= 2^40

maxStates.description: Maximum DP states per column before a scale is abandoned

maxSuffixSet.description: Maximum exact suffix-score set size used for pruning

exhaustive.description: Resolve an unresolved band by unbounded enumeration (always exact)

score.description: The requested score, or the computed threshold (null when scoreAboveMaximum)

scoreAboveMaximum.description: True when even the best word has P(S >= max) > pValue (no word score qualifies; p-value 0)

pValue.description: P(S >= score); the conservative upper bound when isExact is false

isExact.description: True when the p-value is exact

granularity.description: Scale g of the integer-rounded matrix that resolved it (0 = decided without rounding)

errors.message: At least one sequence is required.
PWM cells must be finite: use a positive pseudocount.
background must have one value per alphabet symbol.
Give exactly one of score or pValue

examples.name: P-value of a protein site score
